fusions.name: Dust Raiser
fusions.desc: Kicks up a cone of dust 4 tiles long that deals 4 blunt damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each hit [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Mile Marker
fusions.desc: A hard kick that deals 14 blunt damage, stuns for 1 second and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Beaten Track
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 8% shorter.
